verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents automations: rules, webhooks and online evaluations (langsmith-docs-4, langsmith-docs-10). However, nothing in the pack shows those automations can be versioned, reviewed through a change history or approval flow, or rolled back. Evaluations that 'compare versions' of an application (langsmith-docs-19) are about testing app versions, not versioning automation configs, so they earn no credit here.
